market_analysis.market_definition: The India AI in Geospatial Imaging & Remote Sensing Market covers companies providing the following. Products and technology: AI software: computer vision, deep learning, GeoAI platforms, foundation models; data source: drone imagery, satellite imagery, LiDAR, thermal, hyperspectral, IoT; hardware: edge AI modules, GPU/cloud infrastructure. Services and business models: AI model development, data annotation, image analytics, defect detection, change detection, managed analytics, platform subscription. Applications: Infrastructure inspection, crop health, forestry, land-use classification, utilities, disaster response, smart cities, environmental monitoring, defense. End users: Government, telecom, energy and utilities, construction, agriculture, mining, insurance, transportation, environmental agencies. Geography: India -- companies HEADQUARTERED IN India (a foreign company's Indian office, branch or distributor does not qualify).
market_analysis.core_scope: A core player itself provides AI for geospatial imagery and remote sensing under its own name: GeoAI platforms and foundation models, computer vision on satellite, drone, aerial, LiDAR, thermal or hyperspectral imagery, image analytics, change and defect detection, managed geospatial analytics, or geospatial data annotation. Earth-observation and drone-data companies with their own AI analytics qualify.
